name: Michael Gahler - Après le considérant V - Am 7
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: Va. whereas Ukraine’s accession would entail significant budgetary implications for the EU, in particular for the common agricultural policy and cohesion policy; whereas recent studies indicate that enlargement would have substantial redistributive effects on current allocations and could place additional pressure on the EU’s less developed regions, including those in southern Italy;
